cards.example_en: Wild pandas exist mainly in the mountains of Sichuan.
cards.example_zh: 野生大熊猫主要存在于四川的山区。

cards.example_en: The exit is at the back of the hall.
cards.example_zh: 出口在大厅后面。

cards.example_en: The company plans to expand into Asia.
cards.example_zh: 该公司计划扩展到亚洲。

cards.example_en: The expansion of the library took a year.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆扩建花了一年。

cards.example_en: The sequel did not meet our expectation after the brilliant first film.
cards.example_zh: 第一部那么精彩，续集却没有达到我们的期待。

cards.example_en: The club covered the expense of the minibus for the away match.
cards.example_zh: 客场比赛的小巴费用由社团承担。

cards.example_en: Our experiment showed that plants grow faster beside a sunny window.
cards.example_zh: 我们的实验表明，植物在向阳的窗边长得更快。

cards.example_en: The firework will explode in the sky.
cards.example_zh: 烟花将在空中炸开。

cards.example_en: The region will export tea this year.
cards.example_zh: 这个地区今年将出口茶叶。

cards.example_en: Don't expose your skin to the sun for too long.
cards.example_zh: 不要让皮肤长时间暴露在阳光下。

cards.example_en: Too much exposure to the sun can burn skin.
cards.example_zh: 过度日晒会晒伤皮肤。

cards.example_en: The school may extend the holiday if snow continues.
cards.example_zh: 如果雪继续下，学校可能会延长假期。

cards.example_en: The referee allowed a short extension after the injury stoppage.
cards.example_zh: 受伤暂停之后，裁判允许比赛短暂延长。

cards.example_en: We did not see the full extent of the leak until we moved the fridge.
cards.example_zh: 直到挪开冰箱，我们才看清漏水的全部范围。

cards.example_en: Paint the external walls before the rainy season starts.
cards.example_zh: 在雨季开始前把外墙刷好。

cards.example_en: Hunting pushed the bird toward extinction.
cards.example_zh: 捕猎使这种鸟濒临灭绝。

cards.example_en: I need extra time.
cards.example_zh: 我需要额外的时间。

cards.example_en: An extraordinary comet was visible from our balcony last night.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚从我们的阳台能看见一颗非凡的彗星。

cards.example_en: The soup is extremely hot.
cards.example_zh: 这汤非常烫。

cards.example_en: This fabric feels soft.
cards.example_zh: 这块布料摸起来很软。

cards.example_en: Good notes facilitate revision before exams.
cards.example_zh: 好的笔记有助于考前复习。

cards.example_en: The new sports facility lets us swim even when the outdoor pool is shut.
cards.example_zh: 有了新的体育设施，室外泳池关闭时我们也能游泳。

cards.example_en: Weather is a factor in the plan.
cards.example_zh: 天气是计划中的一个因素。

cards.example_en: The failure of the first rocket taught the club to check the fuel.
cards.example_zh: 第一枚火箭失败之后，社团学会了先检查燃料。

cards.example_en: She kept her faith in her partner after they lost the opening set.
cards.example_zh: 首盘输掉之后，她对搭档仍然有信心。

cards.example_en: Do you fancy a walk after class?
cards.example_zh: 下课后你想去走走吗？

cards.example_en: The film is a fantasy about dragons.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影是关于龙的奇幻故事。

cards.example_en: The broken window was my fault after the ball game.
cards.example_zh: 球赛之后，那扇打破的窗户是我的过错。

cards.example_en: Helping classmates every day earned her the teacher's favour.
cards.example_zh: 她天天帮助同学，赢得了老师的好感。

cards.example_en: A stone bridge is the main feature of our town.
cards.example_zh: 一座石桥是我们小镇的主要特征。

cards.example_en: The zoo charges a small fee for students on weekends.
cards.example_zh: 动物园在周末向学生收取少量费用。

cards.example_en: She lent a tissue to her fellow passenger on the crowded train.
cards.example_zh: 她在拥挤的火车上把纸巾借给了同行的乘客。

cards.example_en: A female referee controlled the final with a firm whistle.
cards.example_zh: 一位女裁判用有力的哨声掌控了决赛。

cards.example_en: The dog squeezed through a gap in the garden fence.
cards.example_zh: 狗从花园篱笆的一个缺口钻了过去。

cards.example_en: Could you fetch a clean towel from the bathroom?
cards.example_zh: 你能去浴室拿一条干净毛巾吗？

cards.example_en: Vegetables give you fibre.
cards.example_zh: 蔬菜能提供纤维。

cards.example_en: I prefer fiction to news.
cards.example_zh: 比起新闻我更喜欢小说。

cards.example_en: Daily swimming slowly changed his figure over the summer.
cards.example_zh: 每天游泳让他的身形在那个夏天慢慢变了。

cards.example_en: Dad copied the file onto a memory stick at home.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸在家把文件复制到了存储盘上。

cards.example_en: We finally finished the homework.
cards.example_zh: 我们终于做完了作业。

cards.example_en: City finance paid for the new school roof this spring.
cards.example_zh: 市里的财政今年春天支付了新校舍屋顶的费用。

cards.example_en: Dad reads the financial page while he drinks his morning tea.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸早上喝茶时会读报纸的金融版。

cards.example_en: Her finding on bean plants surprised the science club.
cards.example_zh: 她关于豆苗的发现让科学社团吃了一惊。

cards.example_en: My uncle's firm repairs phones in a shop near school.
cards.example_zh: 我叔叔的公司在学校附近的店里修手机。

cards.example_en: The fisherman returned at dawn.
cards.example_zh: 渔民黎明时回来了。

cards.example_en: He raised a fist to cheer.
cards.example_zh: 他举起拳头加油。

cards.example_en: A flash of light crossed the sky.
cards.example_zh: 一道闪光划过天空。

cards.example_en: This soup has a mild flavour.
cards.example_zh: 这汤味道清淡。

cards.example_en: I have flexible working hours.
cards.example_zh: 我有灵活的工作时间。

cards.example_en: The eagle's flight over the valley looked calm and strong.
cards.example_zh: 鹰飞越山谷的飞行看起来平稳而有力。

word.example_en: The committee is in favour of a later start.
Can you figure out the last step?
word.example_zh: 你能想明白最后一步吗？
